intro.title: Recursive TreeView
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build a TreeView component that displays hierarchical data, like a file system or organizational chart, using Vue's reactive system. You'll learn how to implement recursion—a function that calls itself—to render nested tree structures of any depth. The lesson will cover Vue components, props, and conditional rendering with v-if to handle parent-child relationships. By the end, you'll understand how to create flexible, reusable components that can display complex nested data efficiently.
intro.usecase: Recursive TreeView components are essential in modern applications where hierarchical data needs to be displayed and navigated. You'll find them in file explorers like Windows File Explorer or macOS Finder, where folders contain subfolders in nested structures. They're also used in document outlines in tools like Notion or Google Docs, organizational charts in HR software, and category filters in e-commerce platforms like Amazon. As a Vue developer, you'll implement these patterns to create intuitive navigation systems that users can expand and collapse to explore complex data relationships efficiently.
